Name: 6 Cylinders (2x3) - Barricade - Gas Cylinder Rack
Natural: This gas cylinder storage rack is recommended for indoor or outdoor bulk cylinder storage of gas cylinders up to 12 inches in diameter. Barricade racks surround cylinders with a two inch square steel tube, which is continuously seam welded and sealed with exterior grade powder paint. Suitable for the storage of most acetylene, argon, butane, carbon dioxide (CO2), helium, hydrogen and nitrogen cylinders. The cylinder holder includes two levels of welded steel chains and snaps for each cylinder. This gas cylinder storage rack meets or exceeds UFC, NFPA, CGA, OSHA, and Seismic Zone 4 requirements. It is made in the USA. Gas Cylinder Storage Rack Dimensions (WxDxH): 30" x 38" x 30".
